sentences.sentence_text: Owned Unify Consulting’s mandate to industrialize an agentic AI roadmap for regulated enterprise adoption, uniting control-plane architecture, cloud and data foundations, lifecycle governance, and alliance distribution into a productized operating model that transformed client-specific engineering into repeatable intellectual property and extensible platform offerings.
